proposal: Contractor designs, builds and removes the landing at its cost (within ER-02.14); Owner applies for the coastal permit within 30 days of receiving the design and obtains it by 2027-09-30, so the landing is built in the Oct 2027 - Apr 2028 window.
question: The GT (about 460 t), generators (about 330 t) and GSU transformers (about 280 t) cannot use the state road. We plan a temporary barge landing on the 60 m public coastal strip. ALP-OWN-GEN-001 says the Owner can apply for the coastal permit (about 6 months). Please confirm the Owner obtains the permit and the dates.
response: Confirmed: the Contractor designs, builds, operates and removes the temporary barge landing at its cost (ER-02.14). The Owner applies for the coastal permit within 30 days of receiving the Contractor's permit design and will use reasonable endeavours to obtain it by 2027-09-30. Please state when the permit design will be submitted.
